aiResearchSummary.text: Standard Cyborg is focused on enhancing 3D data interaction capabilities. Their research includes a toolkit for 3D modeling, which involves operations such as accessing image data streams, applying bit masks to identify portions of image data, and handling additional data streams for comprehensive 3D rendering. This toolkit streamlines the process of creating and manipulating 3D models, facilitating more efficient and precise interactions with 3D data. The company's R&D efforts are concentrated on improving the user experience in 3D data manipulation and model generation.
